title: Prompt-template contamination: does the chat template inflate apparent steering success?

original_idea.body: Prompt-template contamination: extract a vector under several chat templates, cross-apply, quantify template-by-vector interaction. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: template sensitivity affects steering reliability, but catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple factorial cross-template design with CAA; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped factorial experiment (template x vector) with clear effectiveness metric (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Mixed: externally-doable reliability slice, but template-artifact warnings already flagged by Tan et al. (level 3).

novelty.reasoning: Tan et al. already warn steering effects may be template-driven; this largely confirms it.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Template-artifact concern already raised in cited work.
